APPROVE
`Replaced` drops to roughly 1–2 because the loops are now LINQ and the logic moved into helpers; the skip conditions are correctly inverted (`Key == removed.Key || Universal` is the exact negation of the old `continue`), `Any` keeps the same evaluation order and short-circuiting, and every new helper uses all of its parameters and relies only on LINQ the file already imports, so it should build cleanly.
